name: glass-sheet
summary: A floating glass bottom sheet that follows your finger and snaps with velocity.
props: Called after it is dragged, flung, tapped or back-buttoned closed.
Resting heights in points or % of the screen; without them one snap sized to the content (capped below the status bar).
Fires when it settles on another snap.
Float inset from the screen edges with every corner rounded (iOS 26); false docks it edge-to-edge.
Gap to the screen edges when detached.
Force light or dark glass and ink.
Allow drag-down / backdrop tap / back to close; otherwise it rubber-bands at the lowest snap.
Light tap on open, selection tick on each snap.
Edge-to-edge: padding above the home indicator; pass useSafeAreaInsets().bottom for the device.
Sheet style (e.g. maxWidth) and the scrolling content container.
Sheet content; scrolls at the top snap when taller than the sheet.
behavior: Drag from the grabber or the content. Release velocity picks the snap point, and a fling down or a backdrop tap dismisses it.
It springs up over a fading dim and the grabber widens while held. Without snapPoints it sizes to its content, and taller content scrolls.
Snapping, opening and closing use short timings instead of springs.
A light tap on open and a selection tick each time it settles on a snap point.
The sheet is modal and the escape gesture closes it. The grabber is adjustable: increment and decrement step between snap points, and decrement from the lowest one closes it.
Real Liquid Glass on iOS 26, material blur on older iOS and web, and a frosted surface on Android. Android back closes it.
